newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee eases, devaluation talk denied.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee eases, devaluation talk denied.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.05 rupees down at 40.35 to the dollar in kerb trade on Tuesday amid rumours of an imminent devaluation, dealers said.
A central bank spokesman denied any devaluation plan.
Dealers said speculation that devaluation might be part of an economic rescue package being worked out with the International Monetary Fund had prompted big investors to take long dollar positions.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, set on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed at 8.90 percent, compared to its previous close at 8.70 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192 :
